claim: Minimal ISA-level reproducer for the aiter CK attention divergence. A hand-built gfx950 kernel (tools/mfma_isa_test/, clang -x hip, uniform constant operands so expectations are layout-independent) exercises v_mfma_f32_32x32x16_bf16 with C/D in AGPR chained twice (expect 32.0f in every accumulator element), v_accvgpr_write/read roundtrip (expect 100.0f), and v_pk_mul_f32 (expect 3.0f). Result: lane 0 returns all four expected values; lanes 1-63 return 3.0f (the v6 constant) in the mfma and accvgpr slots -- per-lane AGPR state is aliased to ordinary VGPR contents for every lane but lane 0. This is the root functional defect behind the aiter mha_batch_prefill divergence (multi-key attention corrupt, single-key identity exact) and is reproducible in seconds via tools/qwen35_mfma_isa_capsule.py under the lane runner. Triton tl.dot with VGPR accumulators is bit-exact, isolating the defect to the AGPR/accumOffset unified-file model (wavefront.cc accumOffset propagation, register_manager allocation, or the MFMA/accvgpr operand mapping).
next_suspects: MFMA/accvgpr operand read for selector>=256 plus accumOffset

symptom.lanes_1_63: mfma_a0=mfma_a1=accvgpr_roundtrip=3.0 (v6 constant pollution), pk_mul_lo bad on 48 lanes
